narrative.overview:
MintReview is a book of record for people's work. Every screen should read like a well-kept ledger: quiet slate paper, exact figures in aligned columns, and colour only where it carries meaning. Scores, increments and PIPs are sensitive, so the interface never raises its voice. It states facts plainly, shows who did what, and lets the person act on the next step.

Density is moderate to high and built for office desktops: compact 32px controls, 13–14px text, 20px card padding. Hierarchy comes from weight and spacing, not size jumps or colour. A single indigo accent, taken from the logo, marks the one main action and where you are; everything else is slate. Status colours (emerald, amber, rose, sky) appear only as small, tinted badges and dots, never as large fields.

Light and dark themes are equal citizens; every surface, border and badge has a dark counterpart.
keyCharacteristics: Slate neutrals with one Ledger Indigo accent.
IBM Plex Sans throughout; numbers always in tabular figures.
Flat cards on a pale paper background, separated by hairline borders rather than shadows.
Status shown as tinted badges with a dot, never as solid colour blocks.
Motion is short (150–220ms), opacity and small translate only, and fully disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ledger Indigo is the only accent. It marks the main action and the current location; it never decorates.

rules.name: The No-Purple Rule
rules.body: Violet, purple and fuchsia do not exist in this interface; those Tailwind utilities are remapped to slate. The logo's multicolour "M" stays in the logo; only its indigo (the accent) and steel blue (charts) are used in the interface.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status colour appears as a tinted badge or a small dot, never as a solid block behind content.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in tabular figures (`tabular-nums`, `font-mono` or `data-numeric="true"`) so it lines up in tables and cards.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps by weight and colour; no heading or text is set larger than 20px. Only key figures (stat values, headline scores) go larger, 24px and up, always tabular.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Content in the page never carries a shadow. Shadows mean "this floats above the page" and are reserved for modals, popovers and toasts.

dos: Do use the `indigo-*` utilities for the accent; they render Ledger Indigo.
Do use `Button`, `StatusBadge`, `PageHeader`, `SegmentedControl` and the `formStyles` classes instead of restyling by hand.
Do set every score, percentage and amount in tabular figures.
Do give every surface, border and badge a `dark:` counterpart.
Do keep PIP and rating states in calm amber tints, with a clear next action.
donts: Don't use violet, purple or fuchsia, or use the logo's orange, yellow or green as accents (they read as status colours). Chart series colours come from src/config/chartColors.ts.
Don't put shadows on cards or other in-page content.
Don't fill large areas with status colour; use tinted badges and dots.
Don't add a second filled primary button to the same panel.
Don't add a second typeface or a monospace font.
